author: Xinlong12580
body:
## PR description

This PR adds an opt-in neural-network cluster parameter estimator, `PixelCPENNReco`, for Phase-1 barrel pixel hits.

The CPE runs separate TensorFlow models for the local x and y coordinates. The inputs are the normalized one-dimensional cluster projections, total cluster charge, and track incidence angles. Seven pairs of models cover the Layer-1 flipped/unflipped geometries, Layer 2, and the positive/negative module regions of Layers 3 and 4. The network outputs a hit-position offset and uncertainty in each coordinate. Outputs are converted to CMSSW units and checked for finite, positive, and physically bounded values before they are used.

`PixelCPENNReco` derives from `PixelCPEGeneric` so that the standard Generic CPE can be used consistently whenever the NN is not applicable. Generic reconstruction is used for:

- FPIX hits, for which no NN models are provided;
- reconstruction without track angles;
- clusters that cannot be represented by the NN input dimensions; and
- non-finite, non-positive, or out-of-range NN outputs.

The implementation also handles Phase-1 big pixels using the topology API, orders wide rows and columns before expanding them, and uses the track prediction when converting the selected cluster centre into local coordinates so that detector surface deformations are taken into account.

The TensorFlow sessions are created and owned by `PixelCPENNRecoESProducer`. The producer obtains the same magnetic-field, Lorentz-angle, Lorentz-angle-width, and GenError conditions needed by `PixelCPEGeneric`, allowing the fallback to use the configuration and conditions of the standard Generic CPE.

No standard reconstruction configuration is changed. The new CPE is enabled only by explicitly applying:

```python
from RecoLocalTracker.SiPixelRecHits.customizePixelCPENN import customizePixelCPENN
process = customizePixelCPENN(process, "/path/to/model/directory")
```

The customizer copies the active `PixelCPEGenericESProducer` parameters, including era-dependent modifications, creates the NN ESProducer, and changes `TTRHBuilderAngleAndTemplate` and `TTRHBuilderAngleAndTemplateWithoutProbQ` to use `PixelCPENNReco`. Consequently, this customization affects the track-angle-dependent transient-hit/refit stage; it does not replace the CPE used by the initial `siPixelRecHits` production.

The TensorFlow dependency is attached only to the conventional `RecoLocalTrackerSiPixelRecHitsPlugins` library. It is not added to the main `RecoLocalTracker/SiPixelRecHits` library or to the Alpaka plugin library.

### Model files

The trained graph files are intentionally not included in CMSSW. They are supplied through the `modelDirectory` argument when the customization is applied. Activating the customization loads fourteen graphs from that directory: one x model and one y model for each of the seven supported barrel geometries. Workflows that do not apply the customization neither load the graphs nor instantiate the NN CPE.

### Scope and limitations

- NN inference is currently supported only for the four-layer Phase-1 barrel pixel detector.
- FPIX and no-track-angle reconstruction use `PixelCPEGeneric`.
- An invalid model path, incompatible tensor names, or an incompatible graph interface is treated as a configuration error and can terminate the job. Numerically invalid outputs from a compatible graph fall back to `PixelCPEGeneric`.
- This implementation performs one x and one y inference per applicable hit; batching and performance optimization are outside the scope of this PR.

## PR validation

- The touched C++ sources were formatted with the CMSSW code-format target.
- The final topic contains changes only in `RecoLocalTracker/SiPixelRecHits` and does not modify standard CFFs or commit model weights.
- `git diff --check` passes for the complete topic.
- Perforance of our NN has been tested.
